cocaine.overview: Gather the requirements, head to one of the coke islands, pick coca leaves, then process them into Fresh Cocaine Bricks and take them to the lab.
cocaine.requirements:
Coca Leaves (picked on the islands)
Cement (8 bags per 200 leaves)
Gasoline (1 per 10 Coca Blend)
Hydrochloric Acid (1 per 2 Coca Paste)
Empty bags (take them to the lab with the bricks)
cocaine.locations:
Island 1: Above Cayo Perico.
Island 2 (hidden): In line with the mining area, a few hundred metres out to sea.
Island 3: Top right of the map.
Island 4: Left side of the map, in line with Zancudo.
Coke lab: Postal 720.
cocaine.steps:
Gather coca leaves.
Gather Gasoline and Hydrochloric Acid.
Head to an island with the Gasoline, Hydrochloric Acid and leaves.
Go to the pit and put in 200 leaves (50 at a time) and 8 Cement (2 at a time).
Run around the pit (use /walk quick) collecting all the paste until you are out of leaves and Cement.
Put the Coca Blend and Gasoline into the barrels, 10 Coca Blend per 1 Gasoline.
Put the Coca Paste and Hydrochloric Acid into the cooking wok, 2 Paste per 1 Hydrochloric Acid.
Take the Fresh Cocaine Bricks and empty bags to the coke lab at postal 720.
cocaine.tips:
Use 8 bags of Cement per 200 leaves in the mixer.
Use 1 Gasoline per 10 Coca Blend.
Use 1 Hydrochloric Acid per 2 Paste.
The coke lab is owned by La Raza. They don't care about the islands, but they tax or rob at the lab.
If you are avoiding the tax, have someone watch the lab from a distance so you are ready.
You can carry someone while stomping the coca leaves and Cement. It speeds things up because two people are technically doing it, which is handy if someone is in head.

hobo-camps.overview: Search hobo camps around the city for loot. Level up through the Hobo King's tasks to find more and better loot, and loop between the four camps, since each one can only be picked about every 10 minutes.
hobo-camps.requirements:
Visit the Hobo King, down the stairs at the first camp near VU.
Aim to reach level 5 or higher as soon as you can. The higher your level, the better your loot.
hobo-camps.locations:
Camps 1 and 2: Under the Olympic Freeway in Strawberry, near VU (by postals 200 and 125). The Hobo King is down the stairs at the first camp.
Camp 3: Under the bridge near MRPD, between postals 215 and 216.
Camp 4: Up north at postal 3029, off the Great Ocean Highway.
hobo-camps.steps:
Head to the Hobo King, down the stairs at the first camp near VU.
Check your milestones, your daily tasks and the city-wide daily tasks.
Complete the tasks and collect them to level up. They reset every restart.
Pick the first two camps near VU.
Head to the camp under the bridge near MRPD.
Drive up north to the camp at postal 3029.
Head back down and start the loop again.
hobo-camps.tips:
The higher your level, the more loot and the better loot you find in bins and hobo camps.
Each camp can only be picked about every 10 minutes, so clear one area and move on in a big loop.
If someone else picks a camp, wait a little and you can usually pick it too. If they pick it while you are out of the area, it does not affect your picking.

bin-diving.overview: Run up and down the alleyway at postal 323 searching the bins. Keep a powersaw in your pockets so you can open locked bins too.
bin-diving.requirements: Powersaw, bought from YouTool at postal 121. Keep it in your pockets to open locked bins.
bin-diving.steps:
Buy a powersaw from YouTool at postal 121 and keep it in your pockets.
Head to the alleyway at postal 323.
Run up and down the alleyway searching the bins.
With the powersaw in your pockets, open the locked bins as well.
bin-diving.tips: Your Hobo King level also improves what you find in bins. The higher your level, the more loot and the better loot. See the Hobo Camps guide for how to level up.

metal-detecting.overview: Buy a Metal Detector from YouTool, head to Vespucci Beach and search the sand for items. Each search takes about 20 seconds, and you can keep going until you are bored or out of pocket space.
metal-detecting.requirements:
Metal Detector (bought from YouTool, aka Bunnings, at postal 121)
Free pocket space for what you find
metal-detecting.locations:
YouTool (aka Bunnings): Postal 121. Buy your Metal Detector here.
Vespucci Beach: Below Sunset. This is where you metal detect.
metal-detecting.steps:
Buy a Metal Detector from YouTool at postal 121.
Head to Vespucci Beach, below Sunset.
Put the Metal Detector in one of your 1-5 quick slots (usually the slots at the top of your pockets).
Press the number for that slot to start detecting.
Complete the 3-stage skill check by pressing the 1, 2, 3 or 4 key it asks for. The keys are random each time.
Wait about 20 seconds while the detector searches for items.
Repeat until you are bored or out of pocket space.

scrap-yard.overview: Search the car wrecks at a scrap yard for parts, then inspect each wreck again for extra parts you can recycle into more materials. Bring plenty of screwdrivers.
scrap-yard.requirements:
Screwdrivers, and plenty of them. Around 50 covers a full run, and each one usually lasts 3-4 uses.
Get screwdrivers by bin picking, or buy them from YouTool at postal 121.
scrap-yard.locations: Scrap yard: Postal 954. There are several scrap yards, but 954 is usually the most peaceful because it is further from the inner city.
scrap-yard.steps:
Head to the scrap yard at postal 954 with your screwdrivers.
Go to a wreck and choose the search wreck option.
Complete the 3-stage skill check by pressing the 1, 2, 3 or 4 key it asks for.
Third eye the same wreck again and choose Inspect wreck to gather more parts.
Move on to the next wreck and repeat.
Recycle the parts you collect for more materials at the recycling centre, postal 3021.
scrap-yard.tips:
Search the wrecks in any order. Finding a route that works for you makes each run quicker.
Only the first search has a skill check. Inspect wreck does not.

recycling-centre.overview: The recycling centre at postal 3021 gives you two options. Out the front, sell your materials or mulch useless junk in the recyclers. Inside, clock in and carry boxes to the drop-off crate for random materials.
recycling-centre.requirements: To sell or recycle out the front: bring the materials and junk you have gathered from bins, hobo camps and the scrap yard.
recycling-centre.locations: Recycling centre: Postal 3021, near Paleto Bay.
recycling-centre.steps:
Head to the recycling centre at postal 3021.
To sell or recycle: talk to the Recyclables Buyer out the front to sell materials, or use the recyclers to mulch useless junk from bins and hobo camps.
To work inside: third eye the bottom of the door, or the floor in front of it, to go in.
Speak to the man inside to clock in.
Third eye one of the outlined boxes and complete the 3-stage WASD skill check to pick it up.
Carry the box to the red highlighted crate near the man and drop it off.
Collect your materials. Both the item and the amount are random.
recycling-centre.tips: If you have nothing the Recyclables Buyer accepts, the buyer shows a Nothing to sell message.
